about: What is wrong with a widget, and with a value for one (#662): the checks the Widgets tab makes before it saves a widget or a value (checkWidgetDef and checkWidgetValue in widgetModel.ts). An agent's widget declarations are checked by the same rules (checkWidgetDef and checkWidgetValue's twins in utk_curio/backend/app/execution/code_references.py). Each answer is the message, or null when the widget or value is fine. Read by src/tests/utils/widgetChecks.cases.test.ts and utk_curio/backend/tests/test_execution/test_widget_checks.py. The declared cases are widgets as a package template declares them: the canvas makes each with normalizeWidgets (its kind's default when it gives none, without its malformed options) before the Widgets tab checks it, and a package manifest is refused with the same answer at load (utk_curio/backend/tests/test_packages/test_template_widgets.py reads them, and the definitions too).
